profile.headline: Software Engineer at Meta

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Created new static analysis detectors to find vulnerabilities in Solidity smart contracts

Built benchmarking infrastructure for comparing detector results with ground truth data, and used these results to reduce false positive rate of detectors by >50% without impacting the correct alerts

Designed and implemented a DSL that allows for expressive unit testing of our tool output and eliminates the need to update the tests when the formatting changes which reduces the time it takes to update an existing detector by 10-20%

Worked on developing a unified output format for all company tools to streamline integration with out SaaS platform

Made an optimization to one of our detectors that reduced memory consumption by >90%

Performed manual security audits on many Web3 projects in languages including Solidity, Rust, Typescript, and Go
positions.insights: Skills: Solidity · C++ · TypeScript · Auditing · Static Analysis · Formal Verification

positions.title: Research Assistant for Professor Yu Feng
positions.description:
Added testing functionality to Eurus (a tool for formal verification of smart contracts), including support for checking reverts which increased the coverage of the Certora specs for the MakerDao project by 60%

Implemented visualization synthesis software using refinement types, and improved benchmark performance by 20%
positions.insights: Skills: Python (Programming Language) · Solidity · Racket · Pandas (Software) · z3 · Rosette

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.locationName: Menlo Park, California, United States · On-site
positions.description:
Built data pipelines that processed >100 Tb of data per day, to use in a PPR based candidate generator for Reels in Watch

Worked on feature extraction for Reels to provide additional information to ML recommendation developers
positions.insights: Skills: Python (Programming Language) · C++ · PHP · SQL

positions.title: Research Assistant at the Hansma Lab
positions.description: Optimized code used for feature detection on pulse data, used to help patients manage chronic pain

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
Deployed financial dashboard to cloud using Docker and Kubernetes, and enabled Zero Trust security

Built a script using D3.js that graphs financial data for automated email updates sent to 100+ developers
positions.insights: Skills: Docker · Kubernetes · Node.js · D3.js · AngularJS

positions.title: Informatics Consultant
positions.description: Migrated existing data about novel ASK1 inhibitors to a corporate database, increasing chemist productivity by 25%
